topics.title: Textbooks
topics.lockedNote: The lock means the previous topic isn't mastered yet. It's only a hint — every topic is open.
topics.emptyHint: Topics will appear here once textbooks are added.
topics.notFoundHint: This topic isn't in your textbooks.
topics.needsHelp: Several attempts on this topic didn't work out — your teacher has been told. You can try again.

topics.quizUnavailable: No quiz is open right now. Quizzes open after the lesson.
topics.explainHint: Explain the topic in your own words

topicPage.noText: The textbook text for this topic hasn't been added yet.
topicPage.learnWithAiHint: Ask about anything you didn't get

chat.title: AI helper
chat.intro: Ask a question about the topic. Answers are based on the textbook.
chat.introHint: You can also select part of the text and tap "Explain".

checkpoint.title: Tushuntir checkpoint
checkpoint.intro: Sardor has misunderstood this topic. Explain it to him in your own words.
checkpoint.introHow: Sardor asks a question — you answer by voice or in writing. Explain the key ideas and the topic is mastered.
checkpoint.alreadyMastered: You've already mastered this topic. You can explain it again if you like.
checkpoint.maxReached: Time's up — the recording stopped at 90 seconds.
checkpoint.typedPlaceholder: Explain it to Sardor in your own words…
checkpoint.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type your answer.
checkpoint.micUnsupported: This browser can't record audio. Type your answer instead.
checkpoint.micMissing: No microphone found. Type your answer instead.
checkpoint.micBusy: Another app is using the microphone (a call, for example). Close it and try again, or type your answer.
checkpoint.micFailed: Couldn't start recording. Type your answer instead.
checkpoint.tooBig: The recording is too large (over 5 MB). Record a shorter one.
checkpoint.tooLong: The recording is too long: 90 seconds at most. Record a shorter one.
checkpoint.unreadable: Couldn't read the recording. Record again or type your answer.
checkpoint.notYetTitle: Not yet — let's try once more
checkpoint.teacherNotified: Your teacher has been told and will help you — meanwhile, you can try again.

ask.menuLabel: Ask the AI about the selected text

quiz.practiceAbout: Questions like the ones you got wrong before. Every attempt starts with new questions.
quiz.rules: Answers are saved straight away. You can change them until you submit.
quiz.doneHint: Each quiz can be submitted once.
quiz.deadlinePassed: This quiz's deadline has passed. Answers can no longer be sent.
quiz.locked: The quiz opens after the lesson.
quiz.noQuestions: There are no questions for this topic yet. Let your teacher know.
quiz.notFoundHint: This quiz isn't yours or hasn't opened yet.

quiz.exitHint: Your answers are saved, so you can continue later.
quiz.hintIntro: Open the hints one at a time. Each one takes you a little closer to the answer.
quiz.noMoreHints: No more hints. Now give it a try yourself!

result.notYet: Not yet — let's go over the mistakes together
result.notSubmitted: This attempt hasn't been submitted yet

review.title: Mistake review
review.preparingHint: Preparing an explanation and a check question for each mistake.
